Breakfast: Baker Hansen at Oslo Central Station or hotel buffet
Lunch: Mathallen Oslo food hall (Vulkan) - seafood soup at Vulkanfisk. Grab extra snacks for the road tomorrow
Dinner: Restaurant Schrøder - classic Norwegian home-cooking since 1910. Order fårikål or kjøttkaker with lingonberry. Nightcap at Grand Hotel rooftop bar
Activities: Fly into Oslo Airport (OSL) (~$800-1,200 round trip, 7-8 hr flight); National Museum ($20 (200 NOK), 1.5-2 hr); Walk the city center (Free, Flexible); Oslo Opera House roof walk (Free, 20-30 min); Vigeland Sculpture Park (Free, 1-2 hr); Evening at Aker Brygge ($8-12/pint, 1-2 hr)
Group Notes: Keep Day 1 light. National Museum and Vigeland Park are easy-paced. Dinner at Aker Brygge.
Lodging: Budget: Citybox Oslo ($95/night); Mid: Radisson RED Oslo ($118/night); Premium: Grand Hotel Oslo ($285/night)
Points of Interest: Vigeland Park [59.9267,10.7097]; Opera House [59.9075,10.7531]; Aker Brygge [59.91,10.73]; National Museum [59.9167,10.7361]; Grünerløkka [59.92,10.76]; Mathallen [59.9217,10.7567]

Directions: Take E18 south from Oslo toward Drammen (45 min, 55 km) | Follow E134 west through Kongsberg and over the mountains toward Haukeli (1.5 hr, 130 km) | Turn onto Rv9 south through Setesdal valley to Evje (1 hr, 95 km)
Breakfast: Hotel buffet in Oslo before departing, or Baker Hansen pastries to go
Lunch: Café Utsikten in Kongsberg or pack from Kiwi in Oslo
Dinner: Evje Hotel restaurant - traditional Setesdal cuisine: spekemat, røykt ørret (smoked trout), homemade flatbread. Walk along the Otra River after dinner
Stops: Kongsberg Silver Mines ($33 (350 NOK), 1-1.5 hr); Setesdal Museum (Rygnestadtunet) ($12 (120 NOK), 45-60 min); Evje og Hornnes Geopark (Free, 30-45 min); Setesdal valley viewpoint (Free, 15-20 min)
Activities: Scenic drive via Kongsberg & Setesdal (Toll road, 3.5 hr); TrollAktiv family rafting on Otra River (~$80 (800 NOK), 2-3 hr); Setesdal Museum Rygnestadtunet ($12, 45-60 min); Evje Mineral Park walk (Free, 30-45 min)
Group Notes: Scenic drive through Kongsberg and the Setesdal valley. TrollAktiv family rafting on the Otra River is the highlight. Evje Hotel is the main lodging option.
Lodging: Budget: Evje Camping & Cabins ($90/night); Mid: Evje Hotel ($160/night); Premium: Hovdestøylen Fjellstoge ($250/night)
Points of Interest: Kongsberg [59.6667,9.65]; Otra River rafting [58.5833,7.7833]; Setesdal Museum [58.75,7.75]

Directions: Take Rv9 south from Evje to Rv45 junction (25 min, 32 km) | Follow Rv45 south through Åseral and Bjørnemoen (40 min, 50 km) | Merge onto E39 south toward Stavanger - ferry crossing at Oanes-Lauvvik (55 min, 85 km)
Breakfast: Hotel buffet in Evje before departing
Lunch: Pack from Coop or Kiwi in Evje, or fish soup at Fisketorget in Stavanger
Dinner: Lervig Taproom - world-class craft beer with small plates. Try the John John DIPA or barrel-aged stouts. Nightcap at Bølgen & Moi
Stops: Lauvvik-Oanes Ferry (~$10 car+driver, 15 min); Månafossen Waterfall (Free, 30-45 min); Sverd i Fjell (Swords in Rock) (Free, 15-20 min); Preikestolen hike trailhead (Free, 4-5 hr); Stavanger city center (Free, Flexible)
Activities: Drive Evje → Stavanger (Toll + ferry, 2 hr 10 min); Pulpit Rock (Preikestolen) hike (Free (ferry+bus ~$15/person), 4-5 hr); Lysefjord cruise ($50 (480 NOK), 2.5 hr); Lervig Brewery tour & tasting ($50 (500 NOK), 1.5 hr); Old Stavanger (Gamle Stavanger) (Free, 1-1.5 hr)
Group Notes: Arrive Stavanger ~11am. Afternoon Pulpit Rock hike (depart before 1pm). Evening at Lervig brewery. Families can split: hikers do Pulpit Rock, others explore Old Stavanger.
Lodging: Budget: Comfort Hotel Square ($100/night); Mid: Clarion Hotel Stavanger ($180/night); Mid: Thon Hotel Maritim ($107/night)
Points of Interest: Pulpit Rock [58.9869,6.1867]; Lervig Brewery [58.97,5.74]; Sverd i Fjell [58.9678,5.6742]

Lunch: Fisketorget (Stavanger Fish Market) - fresh shrimp sandwiches and fish soup
Dinner: Tango Bar & Kjøkken - modern Norwegian cuisine. For casual: Eg & Du wood-fired pizzas. Nightcap at Bølgen & Moi
Activities: Lysefjord RIB Safari ($90 (870 NOK), 1.5 hr); Kjeragbolten hike (Free (ferry included), 6-8 hr); Flor & Fjære island garden ($80 (780 NOK), 4 hr); Norwegian Canning Museum ($8 (80 NOK), 1 hr); Kulleseid Disc Golf (18 holes) (Free, 2-3 hr); Stavanger shopping (Variable, 1-2 hr)
Group Notes: Flex day. Options: challenging Kjeragbolten hike (strenuous), RIB safari, disc golf at Kulleseid, or Flor & Fjære garden trip. Families can split by interest.
Lodging: Budget: Comfort Hotel Square ($100/night); Mid: Clarion Hotel Stavanger ($180/night); Mid: Thon Hotel Maritim ($107/night)
Points of Interest: Preikestolen parking [58.9833,6.1833]; Lervig Brewery [58.9667,5.7333]; Gamle Stavanger [58.9667,5.73]; Sword in Rock monument [58.95,5.7167]

Directions: Take E39 north via Byfjord Tunnel (undersea, 5.7 km) | Continue E39 through Haugesund and Åkrafjorden (2 hr, 140 km) | Ferry crossing at Mortavika-Arsvåg (25 min) | Continue E39 through Sveio and Os to Bergen (1.5 hr, 70 km)
Breakfast: Hotel buffet in Stavanger before departing
Lunch: Café at Avaldsnes Viking Farm - pancakes with brown cheese, or Kiwi picnic at Åkrafjorden
Dinner: Lysverket - modern Norwegian tasting menu (reindeer, monkfish, cloudberry). Walk up Fløyen for sunset at 11pm
Stops: Åkrafjorden Scenic Stop (Free, 15-20 min); Avaldsnes Viking Farm ($15 (150 NOK), 1-1.5 hr); Langfossen Waterfall (Free, 15-20 min); Fantoft Stave Church ($8 (80 NOK), 45-60 min); Bergen city center (Free, Flexible)
Activities: Scenic drive Stavanger → Bergen (Toll + ferry, 4 hr); Mortavika-Arsvåg ferry (~$15 car+driver, 25 min); Langfossen waterfall stop (Free, 15-20 min); Avaldsnes Viking Farm ($15, 1-1.5 hr); Fløyen evening walk (Free, 1-2 hr)
Group Notes: Scenic coastal drive with Åkrafjorden, Langfossen, and Avaldsnes Viking Farm en route. Check into Bergen by late afternoon.
Lodging: Budget: Citybox Bergen ($137/night); Mid: Zander K Hotel ($155/night); Premium: Det Hanseatiske Hotel ($295/night)

Lunch: Bergen Fish Market - ferske reker (fresh shrimp) with bread and mayo, fiskesuppe (fish soup)
Dinner: Colonialen - high-end Norwegian gastro. For casual: Pingvinen (affordable Norwegian home-cooking). Nightcap at 7 Fjell Bryggeri taproom
Activities: Bryggen UNESCO Wharf (Free, 1.5 hr); Fløyen Funicular (Fløibanen) ($12 (120 NOK) round trip, 2-3 hr); Bergen Fish Market ($$, 1-1.5 hr); Ulriken Cable Car ($41 (435 NOK) round trip, 2-3 hr); Fantoft Stave Church ($8 (80 NOK), 45-60 min); Troldhaugen (Grieg Museum) ($15 (150 NOK), 2 hr); 7 Fjell Bryggeri brewery visit ($15-20 tasting flight, 1-1.5 hr)
Group Notes: Full Bergen day. Morning: Bryggen and Fish Market. Afternoon: Fløyen funicular + hike or Ulriken cable car. Evening: brewery or Troldhaugen concert.
Lodging: Budget: Citybox Bergen ($137/night); Mid: Zander K Hotel ($155/night); Premium: Det Hanseatiske Hotel ($295/night)
Points of Interest: Bryggen Wharf [60.3975,5.3233]; Fløyen Funicular [60.395,5.33]; Bergen Fish Market [60.395,5.315]; Ulriken Cable Car [60.3817,5.32]

Directions: Take E16 east from Bergen through the Arnanipa tunnel (10 min, 12 km) | Continue E16 through Dale and Vaksdal along the fjordside (45 min, 55 km) | Pass through the Stalheimskleiva hairpin bends (steep, narrow, epic views) | Arrive Voss from the east (25 min, 38 km)
Breakfast: Hotel buffet in Bergen before departing
Lunch: Tvindefossen Kiosk - pølse i lompe and waffles, or Kiwi in Voss for picnic by Lake Vangsvatnet
Dinner: Park Hotel Vossevangen - local trout, lamb, and wild game. After dinner, walk around Lake Vangsvatnet. Nightcap at Voss Microbryggeri
Stops: Tvindefossen Waterfall (Free, 15-20 min); Stalheimskleiva viewpoint (Free, 15-20 min); Nærøyfjord viewpoint (Gudvangen) (Free, 20-30 min); Voss Gondola ($25 (250 NOK) round trip, 1-2 hr)
Activities: Scenic drive via Stalheimskleiva (Free, 1.5 hr); Voss family rafting Grade 2 ($90 (870 NOK), 3 hr); Voss Gondola to Hangurstoppen ($25 (250 NOK) round trip, 1-2 hr); Voss MTB Park (gondola-assisted) ($30-50 bike rental, 2-4 hr); Voss Active High Rope + Zipline Park ($40 (400 NOK), 2-3 hr); Whitewater rafting Grade 3 ($110 (1,100 NOK), 3 hr)
Group Notes: Morning drive to Voss. Afternoon rafting (Grade 2 family or Grade 3 thrill). Teens will love the zipline park. MTB on gondola-assisted trails. Gondola sunset.
Lodging: Budget: Voss Vandrarheim Hostel ($45/night per person); Mid: Park Hotel Vossevangen ($365/night); Premium: Stalheim Hotel ($280/night)

Directions: Take E16 east from Voss toward Vinje (15 min, 18 km) | Turn onto Rv13 south through the Granvin tunnel toward Hardangerfjord (30 min, 25 km) | Follow Rv13 along Hardangerfjord through Ulvik and Eidfjord to Kinsarvik (1.25 hr, 82 km)
Breakfast: Hotel buffet in Voss before departing
Lunch: Fossli Hotel café at Vøringsfossen - waffles with brunost and coffee with a waterfall view
Dinner: Hotel Ullensvang Restaurant - local trout, Hardanger lamb, Telefon cider. Splurge: Iris at Salmon Eye Michelin-starred floating restaurant. Walk the fruit orchards at midnight
Stops: Vøringsfossen Waterfall (Free, 45-60 min); Steinsdalsfossen Waterfall (Free, 20-30 min); Hardanger Bridge viewpoint (Free, 15-20 min); Hardanger Cider Farm ($15-20 tasting flight, 45-60 min)
Activities: Scenic drive Voss → Hardanger (Toll road (Hardanger Bridge), 2 hr); Vøringsfossen Waterfall viewpoint (Free, 45-60 min); Steinsdalsfossen walk-behind waterfall (Free, 20-30 min); Folgefonna Glacier walk (~$100 (1,000 NOK), 4-5 hr); Hardanger Cider tasting ($15-20 tasting flight, 45-60 min); Hardangerfjord evening cruise ($35 (350 NOK), 1-1.5 hr)
Group Notes: Scenic drive with Vøringsfossen and Steinsdalsfossen en route. Afternoon: Folgefonna glacier walk or cider tasting at local farms. Evening fjord cruise.
Lodging: Mid: Thon Hotel Vøringfoss ($150/night); Premium: Hotel Ullensvang ($290/night); Premium+: Iris at Salmon Eye ($450/night)

Lunch: Roadside fruit stand picnic in Lofthus - fresh strawberries, cherries, apples, local cheese. Bread from local bakery
Dinner: Hotel Ullensvang Restaurant - farewell dinner with Hardanger trout and grilled lamb. Cloudberries with cream for dessert. Pair with Hardanger cider. One last fjord sunset walk at 11pm
Activities: Hardangervidda plateau hike (Free, 2-4 hr); Ulvik Fjord kayaking (~$90 (870 NOK), 2-3 hr); Eidfjord Coastal MTB ride (Free (bike rental ~$30), 1.5-2 hr); Cider farm & fruit basket shopping ($10-25, 30-60 min); Hardanger Nature Center ($10 (100 NOK), 1-1.5 hr); Farewell dinner ($30-60, 1.5-2 hr)
Group Notes: Final full day. Options: Hardangervidda plateau hike, Ulvik kayaking, or cider farm visits. Farewell dinner at Hotel Ullensvang.
Lodging: Mid: Thon Hotel Vøringfoss ($150/night); Premium: Hotel Ullensvang ($290/night); Premium+: Iris at Salmon Eye ($450/night)
Points of Interest: Hardangervidda Plateau [60.05,7.4167]; Ulvik [60.5667,6.9167]; Lofthus [60.3333,6.65]; Hardanger Bridge [60.4833,6.8333]; Herand Beach [60.35,6.3833]

Breakfast: Hotel buffet or Baker Hansen at Bergen Station
Dinner: On the plane or at home
Activities: Fly home from Bergen Airport (BGO) (-, 7-8 hr flight); Morning in Bergen (if late flight) (Free, 1-3 hr); Duty-free at BGO (Variable, 30-60 min)
Group Notes: Departure day from Bergen Airport (BGO). Flytoget or taxi to airport.
